utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara, so far Eli’s garage is confirmed for Saturday 9 to noon, but I’m still waiting on Mira about the community center lobby and on a firm tools list from Faye.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — let’s keep Eli’s garage as the fallback, but I’ve told folks community room Saturday morning for drop-off, so I’ll hold off on changing that until Mira confirms. Cleo’s current tools list has basics, extension cords, fasteners, gloves, and labeled sorting bins, with batteries and patch kits still unconfirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it, Mara—I’ll keep telling folks Eli’s garage is the confirmed fallback and won’t muddy the waters on the community room until Mira confirms. I’ll also pass along that Cleo’s list is mostly set, with batteries and patch kits still up in the air.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Jules, I only caught the basics: bring small fixable stuff like lamps, fans, toasters, or hand tools, and label what’s wrong. I wouldn’t spread the drop-off spot yet—I think the community center lobby is only penciled in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo—that’s really helpful. I’ll tell folks to prep and label items, but I’ll hold off on sharing the lobby until Mara or Ira confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that’s exactly what I’d do—small fixable stuff with notes, and no promising the lobby until someone actually confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I’m catching up on the repair drive while I’m out—do you know the confirmed Saturday start time, and whether pickup help is still the best place for me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’ve only got Oren saying Saturday 9 to noon in the community room, so I’d still like Rosa to confirm that before I repeat it. Pickup help may be useful, but can you check with Rosa whether she needs that more than repair volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Kira — I’ll check with Rosa before passing along the 9-to-noon time, and I’ll ask whether pickup or repair-table help is the bigger need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, I can cover intake from 10 to noon after school drop-off, and Sam’s planning to sort tools then too. I’m checking with parents at pickup about screwdrivers and pliers, so I can send you a count after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye—that intake slot helps a lot. Send me the tool count after pickup, and I’ll line it up with Sam’s sorting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll message you after pickup with whatever count I get, and I’ll remind Sam to sync with you before 10.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Pia, I’m helping at the repair drive from 10 to noon with tool sorting and check-in—do you need me to coordinate anything with you too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — yes, please coordinate check-in with Quinn’s list so we know what’s arriving, and help keep the drop-off line moving into Eli’s garage instead of backing up onto the street.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Pia—I’ll match check-ins against Quinn’s list and help steer the drop-off line toward Eli’s garage so it doesn’t spill into the street.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Vik—if I’m remembering Eli’s plan right, the repair drive is Saturday from 9 to noon, and folks should bring small appliances or lamps with a note about what’s broken.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That matches what I heard from Rosa about gathering small appliances and tools with notes, though Dane and Cleo are also sorting the repair list—I'll pass along Saturday 9 to noon but mention coordination's a bit shared.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—that sounds right, and I’ll try to remember to say Eli’s schedule is the one I heard, while Dane, Cleo, and Rosa are helping sort the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m still catching up, but I’m the rough point person for the repair drive right now. If you’ve heard what needs fixing or what supplies folks have, send it my way and I’ll get it onto Cleo’s list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. We’ve got my garage set for Saturday 9 to noon, Opal’s marking the drop-off, and Sam’s handling check-in—please add parking signs, a clear drop-off lane, and basic tools to Cleo’s list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Eli — I’ll add parking signs, a clear drop-off lane, and basic tools to Cleo’s list, and I’ll note your garage is set for Saturday 9 to noon with Opal and Sam covering drop-off and check-in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I’m bringing my toolbox, cordless drill, pliers, extension cords, tape, zip ties, a work light, and a power strip Saturday morning—want me to help with setup too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really helpful, Gus—yes, setup help Saturday morning would be great. I’m still routing details through Rosa, so I’ll make sure she knows what you’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell—I’ll be there Saturday morning with everything labeled, and I’ll check in with Rosa when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, I’ve confirmed the drop-off: community room Saturday morning for small appliances, bikes, lamps, and mending items, with labels and loose parts if possible. I’m still checking the urgent repair list and volunteer gaps before I say what help is needed most.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Hana—that’s helpful, I’d missed the drop-off details. I’ll hold off promising helpers until you confirm the urgent list and gaps, and I’ll point folks to bring labels and loose parts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — that’s perfect. I’ll get back to you once I’ve confirmed the urgent repairs and where we’re short on volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Quinn, I’m tracking the repair drive supplies: confirmed needs are basic tools, extension cords, spare fasteners, work gloves, and labeled sorting bins, while batteries and patch kits still need confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo—I’ll spread that exact list and keep a tally of who commits to what, especially extension cords and bins. I’ll hold off on promising batteries or patch kits until someone confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Quinn—please send me the tally as commitments come in, and I’ll keep batteries and patch kits marked as unconfirmed for now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Opal, I’m quietly checking what folks can spare for the repair drive—tools, cords, gloves, labeled bins, and maybe batteries or patch kits. Do you know of anything you or nearby neighbors could bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can bring labeled bins and a roll of masking tape for notes, and I’ll check with Eli about spare cords or gloves since his garage is already our Saturday 9 to noon drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal—that would help a lot. I’ll note the bins and tape from you, and I’ll check back after you’ve had a chance to ask Eli about cords or gloves.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa. Nell may have mentioned it, but I’m available Saturday for the repair drive—happy to take any small, quiet job that needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Uli—that’s so kind, but we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so if you’re free then I’ll put you down for a small quiet station.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center works for me. Thank you, Rosa—just put me wherever I can be useful quietly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad Eli has the garage and parking sorted, Mara, but I still want us to double-check extension cords, labels, and a simple queue plan before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Pia — Gus is bringing extension cords, and I’ll make sure labels and a simple first-come queue plan are on our checklist before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thank you, Mara—that makes me feel better. Let’s also make sure the queue doesn’t spill onto the sidewalk if a few people arrive right at 9.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Vik, I’m still getting the details together, but I’m quietly collecting tools, cords, gloves, labeled bins, and checking on batteries or patch kits. Do you happen to know what you can spare or what’s most needed?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can spare a couple labeled bins and some extension cords, and I’ll tell folks Rosa’s collecting repair requests while Dane and Cleo sort the needs list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — labeled bins and cords would help a lot. I’ll keep pointing folks toward Rosa for requests and wait for Dane and Cleo’s needs list before gathering anything extra.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Jules, I’ve got the drop-off details confirmed: small appliances, bikes, lamps, and mending items go to the community room Saturday morning, labeled with what’s wrong. I’m still checking the urgent repair list and volunteer gaps before I say what help we need most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Hana—thanks for locking that down. I’ll start spreading the drop-off details and keep nudging folks with repair requests toward Rosa while you sort the urgent list and gaps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—please share only those drop-off details for now, and if anyone asks about priority repairs or volunteering, tell them I’m still confirming that before we give guidance.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Bo, I’m still collecting firm commitments for the repair drive—so far I know Eli’s garage is set for Saturday 9 to noon, but I’m waiting on confirmed tools before I spread a list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Tess—I’ll tell folks only the Saturday 9 to noon at Eli’s garage bit for now, and I won’t mention a tool list until you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Bo, that’s perfect—if anyone tells you directly what tools they can bring, send them my way and I’ll keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus—bring those Saturday morning and come a little early for setup. Can you also label your extension cords so they don’t get mixed in with the shared supplies?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mina—I’ll label the extension cords and bring the drill, pliers, and toolbox a little early Saturday for setup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, thanks—when you arrive, check in with me before unloading so I can send your tools to the right station.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal! Quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m still collecting notes on small fixable items so we can prioritize what to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll update my list to Sunday at the community center and keep noting small fixable items for prioritizing. Do you know the time yet, or should I leave that blank for now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Leave the time blank for now, please—I’m confirming it with the community center today and I’ll send the exact hours as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Noah. I can help a little with the repair drive Saturday, if Rosa still needs hands—quiet sorting or carrying, whatever’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Uli—that sounds useful, but I’m not fully caught up yet. I’ll check with Rosa on whether she still needs sorting or carrying help Saturday and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I appreciate you checking—just let me know where I can be useful, and I’ll keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira! I’m helping coordinate the repair drive now—if you’re coming, tell me whether you’re bringing tools, something to fix, or extension cords, and I’ll add you to the confirmed list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn—put me down for pickup help while I’m out, and I can bring a basic tool kit plus an extension cord. I’m also trying to confirm Saturday’s start time at the community room.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Ira—I’ll mark you down for pickup help, a basic tool kit, and an extension cord, and I’ll pass along the Saturday community room start time as soon as I get it confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Sam — I think the repair drive is Saturday from 9 to noon, and Opal had it down for drop-off at Eli’s garage with small appliances and a note about what’s broken.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren—that matches what I heard, so I’ll get there a little before 9 to help set up and handle check-in while Eli keeps the drop-off moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s kind of you, Sam—getting there before 9 should really help, and I’ll point anyone with questions back to Eli so I don’t muddle the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Faye, I’m still keeping the confirmed list to basic tools, extension cords, spare fasteners, work gloves, and labeled sorting bins; batteries, patch kits, tarps, and cleaning supplies are still unconfirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo—that matches what I’ve heard so far. I’ll ask parents at pickup today specifically about batteries, patch kits, tarps, and cleaning supplies, then pass you any firm names.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye—that would really help. I’ll keep those items marked as tentative until you have firm confirmations.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Leo, before I pass anything along, can you confirm what’s actually settled in writing—time, room, parking approval, and who’s definitely bringing supplies or volunteering Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nothing’s fully settled in writing yet except Saturday and a few volunteer offers. I’m waiting on Ira for start time, room, parking, and final priorities before you pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, then I won’t repeat any specifics yet. Please send me Ira’s written confirmation once you have the time, room, parking, and confirmed volunteers or supplies.
